notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is catalogued here and live via DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN (set 2 Sep 2026, PR #230) — same shared uk-darwin.js provider as every other UK region.

Single agency in scope (National Rail incl. Transport for Wales through-running), single mode (train). Transport for Wales Valley Lines is IN-CATALOG via Darwin — confirmed on Darwin by a live probe of all 16 catalog CRS codes 5 Sep 2026 (see docs/south-wales-d1/oracle-clash-report.md 'Re-scope 7 Sep 2026' section). Modelled as line + terminus, termini-only: four of the six named Valley Lines routes have a catalogued terminus here (Merthyr, Aberdare, Treherbert/Rhondda, Rhymney) — Coryton and Ebbw Vale termini have no confirmed CRS in this probe and are NOT catalogued (Tim/D2 item, not resolved here). The ~70 intermediate Valley Lines halts across all six lines also remain out of catalog — a future expansion pass, not a gap in this one.

No doNotGroup needed anywhere in this catalog. Cardiff Central (CDF) is a single Darwin CRS/board, operator-mixed (Valley Lines shares CDF's board with mainline services rather than getting a separate board) — nothing to group against, just for a different reason than the old 'no Valley Lines board exists yet' framing. Cardiff Queen Street (CDQ) is a separate CRS ~600 m away with no shared-board evidence — built as its own plain entry, not grouped with CDF.

Severn Tunnel Junction is catalogued flat, NOT a merge point — through-running-only Wales-England boundary station. RESOLVED per docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md SS2 (Tim, 5 Sep 2026): STJ and West of England's Chepstow (CPW) are both in Wales on different corridors, both home South Wales/West of England respectively, both stay through-running-only — this is no longer an open D2 item.
